title: Cache-aside: the independent copy
description: Suspend a reader, publish a revision, and inspect which copies deletion can reach.
initialCaption: Source 1; held copy and cache empty.
interactionHint: Drag to look around · scroll to zoom
fallback: Deleting a cache key cannot revoke an independently held read. A late fill can restore revision 1 after source 2 is committed; delete again and fetch source 2 to recover. Expiry is outside this model.
